# KaTeX 0.16.22

Vendored for offline mathematics rendering in `general_fundamentals/riemman_hypothesis.html`.

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.16.22

Distribution source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.22/dist/

`katex.min.js` and the WOFF2 fonts are unmodified upstream distribution files.
`katex.min.css` retains only the WOFF2 font sources, removing redundant WOFF/TTF
fallbacks. The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

No package installation, network connection, or build step is needed to use the
lesson. Keep this directory in place when copying or deploying the webpage.
